documentType.description: Short human-readable classification grounded in the headings, purpose, and contents. Prefer the most specific supported type, or a supported broader type. Examples: Criminal History Record Check Receipt, Utility Bill, Insurance Notice, Lease Agreement, Government Letter, Invoice. Examples are not a fixed list or default. Use Unknown only when the content genuinely cannot be classified; missing dates or unclear actions alone do not justify Unknown. Do not infer legal status or results.

deadline.description: An explicitly stated, unambiguous deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format, otherwise null.

meaning.description: Plain-English explanation, based only on document evidence. Unknown is null.

evidence.description: Short exact excerpts from the document, not explanations or reasoning.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD only if explicit and unambiguous; otherwise null.

evidence.description: Exact document excerpt supporting this date.
